cohort: Singleton pregnancies of at least 28 weeks gestation
finding: While tight glycemic control for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) did not significantly impact birthweight outcomes compared to standard control, it was associated with increased obstetric interventions and a lower incidence of neonatal hypoglycaemia, jaundice, and respiratory distress.
mod_finding: The service with tight glycemic control had a higher rate of elective caesarean section compared to the service with standard control.
